name: Gomer
whenBasis: In Hosea's time: the reigns Hosea 1:1 names, in Thiele's reckoning.
summary: Daughter of Diblaim, the wife Hosea married at the LORD's command to take an adulterous wife. She bore Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah and Lo-ammi, whose names were signs to Israel. Chapter 3, where Hosea buys a woman back for fifteen shekels of silver and some barley and tells her to wait many days, is usually read as her return.
body: The text does not say whether she was unfaithful before the marriage or after, or whether all three children were Hosea's; the second and third are not said to be born to him. Chapter 2 moves from her to Israel without a break.
